text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The hard work we've put in throughout spring and summer bears fruit, and Manhattan Cafe breezes through the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe feels the impact of our efforts too, revealing that this is the closest she's ever gotten to her friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't look the slightest bit unwell either. Maybe our goal of reaching her friend is just a race away… With our fingers crossed, we decide to wrap up the year by taking on the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race is such a significant moment that it attracts a fair share of senior-year runners—like T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto.
